correctness.rationale: For each finite cut S, direct pair counting establishes W(S)-(n-1)U(S)/n=2·sum_{i<j}(a_i-a_j)^2/[r(r-1)n^2]. Cut representation extends this inequality to every L1 metric. Noncontractivity U>=t and D>=W gives D>=max(1,(n-1)t/n). Explicit nonnegative cut combinations tB+[1-t(n-1)/n]P in the subcritical regime and tB in the supercritical regime attain it. Equality of nonnegative squares proves cut balance and pair-distance rigidity. Checked exact all-cut identities on seven small parameter pairs and 1,164 pair distances; no finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: Complete sharp L1 embedding distortion for natural all-size snowflakes of balanced multipartite graph metrics, with a sharp isometry transition independent of the number of parts and rigidity of all supporting cut decompositions. These are meaningful structural features, neither a mere special-case table nor a routine rewording of a known free-space invariant. The old negative-type obstruction supplies necessity but neither sharp sufficiency in real L1 nor the optimal distortion and rigidity.
